name: Tendring Colchester Borders Garden Community - Development Plan Document
organisation-name: Tendring District Council, Colchester City Council

housing-numbers.organisation-name: Tendring District Council, Colchester City Council (Joint Plan)
housing-numbers.notes: This is a joint plan for a single Garden Community site crossing both authority boundaries. The total 7,500 homes will be delivered across three neighbourhoods: South and North Neighbourhoods (6,000-6,500 homes) and Crockleford Neighbourhood (1,000-1,500 homes). The entire site is allocated as one strategic allocation.
